name: Egg & Havarti Tortilla Melt
whyItWorks: Soft eggs and white flour tortillas are near-zero residue; Havarti is naturally lactose-free (~0g lactose) and melts cleanly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Soft-scramble 2 eggs, wrap in a warm white flour tortilla with a slice of plain Havarti, and press in a dry skillet for 60 seconds per side until crispy.
